blocks.h2: When to Call a Hanover Park Drain Plumber
blocks.body: Call when plunging doesn't work, the same drain keeps clogging or you smell sewage. If one drain is slow, the clog is in that branch. If several are slow, or the basement floor drain fills, the main line is blocked and needs [sewer line cleaning](/hanover-park/sewer-rodding).

img.alt: Illustration of common signs a drain needs professional cleaning

blocks.h2: Main Sewer Drain Clearing in Hanover Park
bodies: When the floor drain backs up or every drain slows at once, the main sewer drain is blocked. It takes a machine that can reach from the cleanout to the public sewer.

We clear it and camera it so you see the cause: roots, grease or a low spot where the pipe settled. If it keeps happening, we'll go over [hydro jetting](/hanover-park/hydro-jetting) or a [repair](/hanover-park/sewer-repair).
Hair and soap in bathrooms, grease in kitchens and lint in laundry lines cause most clogs. We clear them and show you what came out.
If a drain keeps clogging, we'll check whether the pipe has buildup that needs jetting.
Grease is behind most kitchen clogs. It coats the pipe and traps food scraps.
If the dishwasher backs up into the sink, the kitchen drain or [disposal](/hanover-park/garbage-disposal-installation-repair) is likely clogged.

blocks.h2: Why Drains Clog in Hanover Park Homes
blocks.intro: Most homes here were built in the 1970s and '80s.

items.body: Lint clogs floor drains and laundry lines.
When every drain is slow, it's the main. See [main sewer drain clearing](#sewer-drain-clearing).

blocks.h2: Drain Cleaning Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: Do you offer emergency drain cleaning?
items.answer: Yes. Call any time and we'll get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: Why do my drains keep clogging?
items.answer: Usually buildup in the pipe. Clearing the clog opens a path. Jetting removes the buildup.

items.q: Is it one drain or the main line?
items.preview: Check how many drains are slow.
items.answer: If only one drain is slow, it's that branch. If several are, it's the main.

items.q: Should I use a chemical drain cleaner?
items.answer: We don't recommend it. It rarely clears the clog and can damage pipes.

items.q: Can you clear a floor drain in the laundry room?
items.answer: Yes. Laundry lint is a common cause. A lint trap on the washer hose helps prevent it.

items.q: How much does drain cleaning cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on where the clog is. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the clog is and what's causing it. You'll approve a flat price before we start.
